Bug_Details: Defaults for AutoValue Builders should be set in the factory method returning Builder instances, not the constructor
Bug_Explanation: Default values for the AutoValue Builder are incorrectly set in the constructor of the Builder class, whereas they should be set in a factory method that returns Builder instances.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case calls the method showBug, which in turn uses the Builder constructor to instantiate the Builder class. Because the default values are set in the constructor, the test fails if those defaults are not correctly set through a factory method.
